pairsWith.noteUz: Majhul nisbat, too/enough, egalik olmoshlari coursebook 65-66-betlar grammatikasiga; ma'lumot so'rash dialogi coursebook 66-bet muloqot bo'limiga mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 9-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (40-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '9' va 'A World of Wonders'.

CHAP USTUN:
(8-mashq davomi, 4-10): 4 That souvenir shop sells beautiful jewellery. sold - Beautiful jewellery ...... that souvenir shop. 5 They have closed that part of the gallery because of the fire. closed - That part of the gallery ...... because of the fire. 6 Miss Jones must write all these letters. written - All these ...... Miss Jones. 7 Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa. painted - The Mona Lisa ...... Leonardo da Vinci. 8 They will organise a yacht race for next Sunday. organised - A yacht race ...... for next Sunday. 9 You can only reach this island by boat. reached - This island ...... boat. 10 They speak Spanish in most of Latin America. spoken - Spanish ...... in most of Latin America.
9) 'Look at the headlines and complete the first line of the newspaper articles.' SARLAVHALAR: 1 ARMED GANG ROBS WESTLAND BANK; 2 FIRE DESTROYS FACTORY; 3 DOG BITES NURSE!; 4 LOCAL COUNCIL TO BUILD HUGE NEW CAR PARK; 5 PRINCE THEATRE INVITES LEONARDO DiCAPRIO TO GIVE CHARITY PERFORMANCE. 1 Westland Bank ...was robbed by an armed gang... at 3 pm yesterday. 2 A factory ...... last night. 3 A nurse ...... on Tuesday morning. 4 A huge new car park ...... the local council. 5 Leonardo DiCaprio ...... at the Prince Theatre.
10) 'Fill in enough or too.' 1 This box is ...... heavy for me to lift. 2 It's ...... hot for us to work outside. 3 He's old ...... to tie his own shoelaces.

O'NG USTUN (10 davomi): 4 I'm just ...... tired to play tennis today. 5 It's sunny ...... for a picnic, isn't it? 6 She didn't buy the watch, as it was ...... expensive. 7 The water is ...... cold to swim in today. 8 John doesn't work hard ...... to be successful.
11) 'Match column A with column B.' A: 1 They aren't fit 2 It is too dangerous 3 Danny isn't clever 4 I am too hungry 5 The museum isn't 6 The film was too long | B: a enough to solve the problem. b to travel alone. c to be interesting. d big enough for the new statues. e to wait for dinner. f enough to climb to the top of the tower.
12) 'Underline the correct word.' 1 Don't take that camera. It's my/mine. 2 They lost their/they tickets. 3 That luggage is ours/us. 4 Paris is her/she favourite city. 5 The strawberry ice cream is your/yours. 6 Just as they unpacked the things for them/their picnic, it began to rain. 7 Ben was very proud of him/his holiday photos and showed them to everyone. 8 Jean had an accident while driving her/hers car.
• 'Communication: Asking for and Providing Information'.
13) 'Fill in how, where, what or when, then read out the dialogue in pairs.' SA: 1) ...... is Notre Dame Cathedral? SB: It's in Paris. 2) ...... was it built? SA: It was built in 1345. 3) ...... is it used for? SB: It's used as a place of worship. 4) ...... tall is it? SA: It is 68 metres high. 5) ...... is Notre Dame famous for? SB: The Cathedral is famous for its stained glass windows.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '40'.

exercises.instructionEn: (Ex. 8 continued) Complete each sentence with two to five words including the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: (8-mashq davomi) Har bir gapni qalin harfli so'zni o'z ichiga olgan ikkidan besh so'z bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL NISBAT - TURLI ZAMONLAR.

  4 present simple: IS SOLD IN
  5 present perfect: HAS BEEN
    CLOSED
  6 must: letters MUST BE WRITTEN
    BY
  7 past simple: WAS PAINTED BY
  8 will: WILL BE ORGANISED
  9 can: CAN ONLY BE REACHED BY
  10 present simple: IS SPOKEN


⚠ 'BY' - BAJARUVChI, 'IN' - JOY:

  'is sold IN that shop' (joy)
  'was painted BY Leonardo'
  (bajaruvchi)
  'reached BY boat' (vosita)


⚠ 'THE MONA LISA':

  = Mona Liza (Jokonda) - Leonardo
  da Vinchi rasmi (1503), Luvr.


⚠ 'A YACHT RACE':

  = yaxtalar poygasi.


⚠ 'LATIN AMERICA':

  = Lotin Amerikasi.

items.textEn: That souvenir shop sells beautiful jewellery. → Beautiful jewellery ___ that souvenir shop.
They have closed that part of the gallery because of the fire. → That part of the gallery ___ because of the fire.
Miss Jones must write all these letters. → All these ___ Miss Jones.
Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa. → The Mona Lisa ___ Leonardo da Vinci.
They will organise a yacht race for next Sunday. → A yacht race ___ for next Sunday.
You can only reach this island by boat. → This island ___ boat.
They speak Spanish in most of Latin America. → Spanish ___ in most of Latin America.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the headlines and complete the first line of the newspaper articles. Headlines: 1 ARMED GANG ROBS WESTLAND BANK 2 FIRE DESTROYS FACTORY 3 DOG BITES NURSE! 4 LOCAL COUNCIL TO BUILD HUGE NEW CAR PARK 5 PRINCE THEATRE INVITES LEONARDO DiCAPRIO TO GIVE CHARITY PERFORMANCE. Example: Westland Bank was robbed by an armed gang at 3 pm yesterday.
exercises.instructionUz: Sarlavhalarga qarang va gazeta maqolalarining birinchi qatorini to'ldiring. Sarlavhalar: 1 QUROLLI TO'DA WESTLAND BANKINI O'G'IRLADI 2 YONG'IN FABRIKANI VAYRON QILDI 3 IT HAMSHIRANI TIShLADI! 4 MAHALLIY KENGASh ULKAN YANGI AVTOTURARGOH QURADI 5 PRINCE TEATRI LEONARDO DiKAPRIONI XAYRIYA ChIQIShIGA TAKLIF QILDI. Namuna: Westland banki kecha soat 15:00 da qurolli to'da tomonidan o'g'irlandi.
exercises.explanationUz:
GAZETA SARLAVHALARI → MAJHUL
  GAPLAR.

  ⚠ Sarlavhalar QISQA (present
  simple, artiklsiz); maqola
  boshlanishi - TO'LIQ majhul gap:

  1 ROBS → was robbed by (o'tgan)
  2 DESTROYS → was destroyed by
    fire
  3 BITES → was bitten by a dog
  4 TO BUILD → will be built by
    (kelajak - 'to' + fe'l)
  5 INVITES → has been invited to
    give ... (present perfect)


⚠ SARLAVHA QOIDASI:

  'X TO BUILD' = X will build
  (kelajak).


⚠ 'AN ARMED GANG':

  = qurolli to'da.


⚠ 'LOCAL COUNCIL':

  = mahalliy kengash (hokimlik).


⚠ 'A CHARITY PERFORMANCE':

  = xayriya chiqishi (daromad
  xayriyaga).


⚠ bite → bit → BITTEN.

items.textEn: Westland Bank ___ at 3 pm yesterday.
items.answer: was robbed by an armed gang

items.textEn: A factory ___ last night.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'last night' → past simple majhul: 'was destroyed by fire'.

items.textEn: A nurse ___ on Tuesday morning.
A huge new car park ___ the local council.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Sarlavhadagi 'TO BUILD' = kelajak → 'will be built by'.

items.textEn: Leonardo DiCaprio ___ at the Prince Theatre.
items.answer: has been invited to give a charity performance
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'has been invited to give a charity performance' (present perfect majhul).

exercises.explanationUz:
TOO / ENOUGH (coursebook 65-bet).

  TOO + SIFAT = juda (haddan
    tashqari - SALBIY):
    'too heavy to lift' - ko'tarish
    uchun juda og'ir
  SIFAT + ENOUGH = yetarlicha:
    'old enough to tie' - bog'lash
    uchun yetarlicha katta

  ⚠ TARTIB:
  too + SIFAT (too hot)
  SIFAT + enough (hot enough)
  enough + OT (enough money)


⚠ 'TOO ... TO' / 'ENOUGH ... TO':

  too tired TO play
  sunny enough FOR a picnic
  hard enough TO be successful


⚠ 'TO TIE SHOELACES':

  = poyabzal ipini bog'lamoq.

items.textEn: This box is ___ heavy for me to lift.
It's ___ hot for us to work outside.
He's old ___ to tie his own shoelaces.
I'm just ___ tired to play tennis today.
It's sunny ___ for a picnic, isn't it?
She didn't buy the watch, as it was ___ expensive.
The water is ___ cold to swim in today.
John doesn't work hard ___ to be successful.

exercises.instructionEn: Match column A with column B.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustunni B ustun bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOO / ENOUGH - GAPLARNI
  BIRLAShTIRISh.

  1 aren't fit ENOUGH to climb (f)
  2 too dangerous TO travel alone
    (b)
  3 isn't clever ENOUGH to solve
    (a)
  4 too hungry TO wait (e)
  5 isn't big ENOUGH for statues
    (d)
  6 too long TO be interesting (c)

  ⚠ 'isn't/aren't' → ENOUGH
  ⚠ 'too' → to + fe'l


⚠ 'FIT':

  = baquvvat, sog'lom.


⚠ 'TO SOLVE A PROBLEM':

  = muammoni hal qilmoq.

pairs.right: enough to climb to the top of the tower.
big enough for the new statues.
pairs.rightUz: yangi haykallar uchun yetarlicha katta emas.

exercises.explanationUz:
EGALIK SIFATLARI va OLMOShLARI.

  SIFAT (+ OT):  my, your, his,
    her, our, their
  OLMOSh (OTSIZ): mine, yours,
    his, hers, ours, theirs

  1 It's MINE (otsiz)
  2 THEIR tickets (ot bilan)
  3 is OURS (otsiz)
  4 HER favourite city (ot bilan)
  5 is YOURS (otsiz)
  6 THEIR picnic (ot bilan)
  7 HIS holiday photos (ot bilan)
  8 HER car (ot bilan)

  ⚠ 'they', 'us', 'she', 'them',
  'him' - ShAXS olmoshlari, egalik
  EMAS.


⚠ 'PROUD OF':

  = ... dan faxrlanmoq.


⚠ 'TO UNPACK':

  = ochib olmoq (sumkadan).

items.textEn: Don't take that camera. It's my/mine.
They lost their/they tickets.
That luggage is ours/us.
Paris is her/she favourite city.
The strawberry ice cream is your/yours.
Just as they unpacked the things for them/their picnic, it began to rain.

sections.title: Communication: Asking for and Providing Information

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in how, where, what or when, then read out the dialogue in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: how, where, what yoki when qo'ying, so'ng dialogni juftlikda o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQATGA SAZOVOR JOY HAQIDA
  SAVOLLAR (coursebook 66-bet).

  WHERE is it? - qayerda
  WHEN was it built? - qachon
    qurilgan (majhul!)
  WHAT is it used for? - nima
    uchun ishlatiladi
  HOW tall is it? - balandligi
  WHAT is it famous for? - nimasi
    bilan mashhur


⚠ NOTRE DAME:

  = Notr-Dam sobori (Parij),
  1163-1345, gotika uslubi.
  ⚠ Kitobda 'built in 1345' -
  qurilish TUGAGAN yil.


⚠ 'A PLACE OF WORSHIP':

  = ibodat joyi.


⚠ 'STAINED GLASS WINDOWS':

  = rangli oynali derazalar
  (vitraj).


⚠ 'USED FOR' / 'FAMOUS FOR':

  Savol oxirida 'for' qoladi:
  'What is it used FOR?'

patterns.formula: X was + V3 by Y at [vaqt].
patterns.exampleEn: Westland Bank was robbed by an armed gang at 3 pm yesterday.
patterns.exampleUz: Westland banki kecha soat 15:00 da qurolli to'da tomonidan o'g'irlandi.

patterns.formula: X is too + SIFAT + to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: This box is too heavy for me to lift.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu quti men ko'tarishim uchun juda og'ir.

patterns.formula: X isn't + SIFAT + enough + to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Danny isn't clever enough to solve the problem.
patterns.exampleUz: Denni muammoni hal qilish uchun yetarlicha aqlli emas.

patterns.formula: Where is X? When was it built? What is it used for? How tall is it? What is it famous for?
patterns.exampleEn: When was Notre Dame built? - It was built in 1345.
